steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP® credential. steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Boot Camp. steps_items.heading: Apply to PMI and Pay Fee
steps_items.text: Submit your PMI application with proof of education and experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online application portal and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) during your three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops and webinars. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting proof of PDUs to PMI.
